tools.name: parse_invoice
tools.description: Read one incoming invoice. Pass a publicly reachable file URL and the country code (de, fr, it, pl, ru, kz, by, us, ae, sa, ua, ge). The API key can be passed once as an X-Api-Key header when the server is added, instead of on every call. Returns a job id and status. Electronic invoices (XML, QR) ar
